archive_rebinding_scope: Only source catalog/split/import and preceding review references rebound to byte-identical preserved inputs. Original review retained; no decisions changed.

families.rationale: ADE 005 requests daily 28-day and listing NPS models; the initialized schema for 007 includes those same outputs plus dimensions/fact models. Spider 001 requests daily/monthly sentiment and listing-host updates; 002 requests a seven-day/week-over-week workflow. Shared project and overlapping components justify a conservative split group, not identical-answer classification.

ADE 003 removes warehouse and analytics models, then asks for a unique customer dimension. Spider starts with a closely related dim_customer implementation, with insertion_timestamp added. ADE 004 and 006 request inventory enrichment; 005 and 006 require inventory deduplication. Setup for 005/006 injects duplicate raw inventory rows, so raw project similarity is not equality of initialized inputs. Group the related project and nested construction/repair tasks conservatively.

ADE f1002 schema explicitly requests finishes_by_driver, most_fastest_laps, most_podiums and most_pole_positions. Those four model paths are absent in both its initialized project and Spider f1001, whose prompt requests those driver statistics. Both f1003 variants diagnose unstable top-N results; both f1010 variants construct lap-time summaries. f1011 requests a diagnostic answer table, not a SQL repair. The wider project group contains distinct objectives and does not assert every pair is an exact duplicate.

All three ADE setups remove local models. 001 requests threads, 002 threads plus conversation metrics, and 003 conversation metrics; the requirements overlap by explicit instruction. Spider begins with seven related conversation/company/contact models and requests admin/team closed-conversation metrics. The same raw project files do not imply the same initialized task or output answer.

limitations: No new verifier certification or successful benchmark trial.
Only initialized project file contents were inspected; database sizes do not prove content equivalence.
All 22 currently belong to train. No new holdout-generalization claim.
DEB shared warehouse, remaining Spider project relations, and full historical exposure review remain unfinished.
Family groups are proposals for the later complete split review, not an automatic eligibility override.
